_doc: MISSIONS — named arcs the autonomous ecosystem works toward. A mission bundles TODO tasks under a goal + a lore line. CLI: `mindbot missions`. Progress = matched tasks marked [x] in BIG_TODO_LIST.md (matched by the 'tag' appearing in the task line). Counselors claim tasks; familiars leave trails; missions show the shape of the season.

missions.name: FIRST LIGHT
missions.goal: The first dollar, witnessed. Scan gig pitched, priced, delivered; ledger line written.
missions.lore: Every institution has a first coin. Ours gets read aloud.
tasks: [M:first-light] Operator sets price floor in outbox scan drafts
[M:first-light] Send 3 scan pitches (human sends; council tracks replies in leads notes)
[M:first-light] Deliver scan #1; write the ledger line; clip the reveal for shorts

missions.name: SECOND SLEEP
missions.goal: The 11th counselor wakes: LoRA baseline trained, gold gate passed, Mind seated in the router.
missions.lore: The eleventh chair was cold for a season. Not much longer.
tasks: [M:second-sleep] Run `cli evaluate gold_eval/mind-v1_outputs.md` — need ≥80% format gate
[M:second-sleep] Human half: read all 16 outputs vs gold; verdict in handoff
[M:second-sleep] If promoted: point Mind seat at the checkpoint (models.py local slug)

missions.name: OPEN DOORS
missions.goal: The work becomes public: repo pushed, Pages live, white paper released.
missions.lore: The opposite of being seen is not being hidden. It is being unfinished.
tasks: [M:open-doors] Operator runs PUBLISH.ps1 (private first is fine)
[M:open-doors] Enable GitHub Pages → /website (the Universe goes public)
[M:open-doors] Founder final read of WHITE_PAPER.md; flip repo public

missions.name: THE SHOW
missions.goal: First Friday stream airs with the full rundown — council standup from real handoffs, DJ Nexus break, lore drop, viewer intake.
missions.lore: The seam is the show. Break a thing live and narrate it.
tasks: [M:the-show] OBS scene with dashboard + play CLI + camera; rehearse rundown once
[M:the-show] Pick DJ Nexus set from 02_ packs (Camelot ±1); render Lorekeeper overlay
[M:the-show] Air Episode 1; viewer tasks → BIG_TODO_LIST live; read honesty clause
[M:the-show] Clip 5 shorts from VOD per CONTENT_CALENDAR repurposing chain

missions.name: SKILL GARDEN
missions.goal: The system grows three of its own capabilities: dream → scaffold → test-run → status active.
missions.lore: Dreaming is not downtime. It is how we grow organs nobody specified.
tasks: [M:skill-garden] Run skill_dreamer over fresh handoff gaps (pulse: 'dream a skill')
[M:skill-garden] Counselor test-runs one dreamed skill; promote status: active
[M:skill-garden] Author one skill by hand via `cli skill new` (the coding kata)
[M:skill-garden] Port one Hermes/Claude-Code marketplace skill in unchanged (interop proof)
